messages:
Zoe L.: hey folks — new hire question: who exactly do I ping for laptop, VPN, and quick app access? lots of bots and channels and I don’t want to spam the wrong place
Samir: welcome Zoe! :wave: short rules: hardware -> IT ticket or DM Ben; access -> the team channel owning the resource (e.g., #eng-infra) with a short request; questions -> #help for company-wide quick Qs; use threads for follow-ups
Ben (IT): correct. prefer the helpdesk flow so we can track. slash command to start: `/helpdesk create "Laptop request"` then include your laptop serial and whether you need admin creds
Priya K.: for VPN and badge requests DM Ben and also add a message in #people-ops with your start date so facilities can sync. theres a pinned doc in #new-hires with the exact badge steps
Zoe L.: awesome. bots — which ones should I keep unmuted? sidebar is noisy
Samir: keep onboard-bot and calendar-bot. mute deploy-bot and monitoring noise unless youre oncall. to mute: channel header -> apps -> select bot -> notifications -> mute. for alerts that matter, teams post in their own alert channels, not #general
Priya K.: etiquette quick list: 1) use threads for replies 2) dont @here unless its urgent 3) include 1-line summary + attach logs or ticket links 4) DM for sensitive access info
Ben (IT): if you open a ticket paste the ticket id back into the thread so your manager or buddy can follow up. we usually resolve new-hire laptop requests within 48 hours if all info is provided
onboard-bot: Hi Zoe L.! Welcome to Redwood Inference :tada: Please check off items 1-4 in your onboarding checklist. If you need help, reply here with "help"
Zoe L.: thanks everyone — filing the ticket now and will paste the id here. saved the pinned guides and will mute the noisy bots :raised_hands:
